audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never states why the lane is hard in the levels it is hard: Inner Flame reaches 950 and Command: Attack reaches 815, so she pokes from outside your answer.
audit.why: The 135-unit range gap is the whole early lane and it is in both kits. Difficulty 7/10 is right; the reason was missing.
audit.corrected: Range gap stated explicitly in tldr, phases[1].why, breakdown.mid and the trading rules.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes were written generically and asserted 'a third of a health bar' with no source. The real spike structure is Mantra availability, not item text.
audit.why: Mantra is available at level 1 and costs no skill point, on 40/38/36/34s, and her passive shortens it off every damaging spell — so her tempo is the spike, and level 6 is yours because your R is a flip while her ult is only more Mantra.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes and phases[5].why restated without invented magnitudes; Mantra's 40s and its passive reduction now stated in breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated. Focused Resolve is a tether, and Riot's own text says the root lands only if the tether is not broken — the page said only 'break it with range or line of sight' as boilerplate.
audit.why: That is the single most actionable fact in the matchup: 675 range, 12s flat, and the root is conditional. Also unstated: Mantra Focused Resolve heals her and extends the root (the anti-heal trigger), Mantra Inner Flame adds a delayed cataclysm on top of the explosion, and Inspire (8-10s) gives shield plus move speed so she leaves your combo.
audit.corrected: Tether condition, 675 range, 12s cooldown, the Mantra heal and the delayed cataclysm all now appear in cooldowns, do's, don'ts and report[5].
sources: champ-data/_kits/karma.json (W text/cd 12/range 675, Q Mantra text, E cd 10/9.5/9/8.5/8)

audit.corrected: Oblivion Orb keyed to the Mantra W heal; the Zed clause removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Karma is called 'he/his/him' in tldr, winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, six phases[].why, four dosFull/dontsFull titles and bodies, and three report entries.
audit.corrected: All corrected in the proposed rewrites.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood pasted verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad pasted under a title about not burning R defensively — catalogue defect 2.
